annotations.title: Explain This Game — why we price an NFL game there

description: Why the PredictionMarketsPicks model prices one NFL game where it does: the Kalshi price and market line, our published win probability and what it is anchored to, the model's own line as a lean in points, each team's power rating split into offense, defense and special teams, the QB gate (PASS, ADJUSTED, FORK with both lines, or HOLD), and the published position (side, Kalshi price, edge) or why none is published. Use for "why do you price <team> vs <team> there", "explain the <team> game line", "what is driving the model on <team>'s game". Pass game as two teams in any form ("Bills vs Chiefs", "BUF@KC") or one team for its game; week defaults to the current week.

game.description: The matchup — two teams in any form ("Bills vs Chiefs", "BUF@KC", "Buffalo at Kansas City"), or one team for its game that week.

week.description: Optional NFL week (e.g. 6). Defaults to the current week.
